questions.text: 12 + 8 × 2 ifodaning qiymati nechaga teng?
questions.explanation: Avval ko'paytirish bajariladi: 8 × 2 = 16, keyin qo'shish: 12 + 16 = 28.

questions.text: 1/2 + 1/3 yig'indisi nechaga teng?
200 ning 15% i nechaga teng?
36 va 48 sonlarining eng katta umumiy bo'luvchisi (EKUB) nechaga teng?
questions.explanation: 36 = 2² × 3², 48 = 2⁴ × 3. Umumiy ko'paytuvchilarning eng kichik darajalari: 2² × 3 = 12.

questions.text: 4 va 6 sonlarining eng kichik umumiy karralisi (EKUK) nechaga teng?
Quyidagilardan qaysi biri tub son?
questions.explanation: Tub son faqat 1 ga va o'ziga bo'linadi. 29 shunday son. 21 = 3 × 7, 27 = 3 × 9, 33 = 3 × 11.

questions.text: 0,25 o'nli kasr qaysi oddiy kasrga teng?
questions.explanation: 0,25 = 25/100. Surat va maxrajni 25 ga qisqartirsak 1/4 hosil bo'ladi.

questions.text: Mahsulot narxi 80 000 so'm edi. Narx 25% ga oshirildi. Yangi narx qancha?
2³ × 2² ifodaning qiymati nechaga teng?
questions.explanation: Asoslari bir xil darajalar ko'paytirilganda ko'rsatkichlar qo'shiladi: 2³ × 2² = 2⁵ = 32.

questions.text: Narx avval 20% ga oshirildi, keyin 20% ga kamaytirildi. Natijada boshlang'ich narxga nisbatan qanday o'zgardi?
questions.explanation: Narx x bo'lsin. Oshgandan keyin 1,2x, kamaygandan keyin 1,2x × 0,8 = 0,96x. Demak narx 4% ga kamaydi. Ikkinchi 20% kattaroq summadan hisoblanadi, shuning uchun narx boshlang'ich qiymatiga qaytmaydi.

questions.text: 2x + 5 = 17 tenglamaning yechimi nechaga teng?
(a + b)² ifoda nimaga teng?
questions.explanation: Yig'indining kvadrati formulasi: (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b².

questions.text: x² − 5x + 6 = 0 tenglamaning ildizlari qaysilar?
questions.explanation: Viyet teoremasiga ko'ra ildizlar yig'indisi 5 ga, ko'paytmasi 6 ga teng. Bular 2 va 3: (x − 2)(x − 3) = 0.

questions.text: a² − b² ifodani ko'paytuvchilarga ajrating.
questions.explanation: Kvadratlar ayirmasi formulasi: a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b).

questions.text: y = 3x − 2 funksiyaning grafigi Oy o'qini qaysi nuqtada kesib o'tadi?
questions.explanation: Oy o'qida x = 0. y = 3 × 0 − 2 = −2, demak nuqta (0; −2).

questions.text: Tenglamalar sistemasini yeching: x + y = 10, x − y = 4.
questions.explanation: Tenglamalarni qo'shsak 2x = 14, x = 7. Unda y = 10 − 7 = 3.

questions.text: 3(x − 2) = 2x + 1 tenglamaning yechimi nechaga teng?
questions.explanation: Qavsni ochamiz: 3x − 6 = 2x + 1. Bundan x = 7.

questions.text: x² + 4x + 5 = 0 tenglamaning diskriminanti nechaga teng va u nechta haqiqiy ildizga ega?
questions.explanation: D = b² − 4ac = 16 − 20 = −4. D < 0 bo'lgani uchun haqiqiy ildizlar yo'q.

questions.text: |x − 3| = 5 tenglamaning ildizlari qaysilar?
questions.explanation: x − 3 = 5 yoki x − 3 = −5. Demak x = 8 yoki x = −2.

questions.text: Arifmetik progressiyada a₁ = 3, d = 4. Uning 10-hadi nechaga teng?
questions.explanation: aₙ = a₁ + (n − 1)d formulasi bo'yicha a₁₀ = 3 + 9 × 4 = 39.

questions.text: Uchburchak ichki burchaklarining yig'indisi necha gradus?
questions.explanation: Har qanday uchburchakda (Yevklid geometriyasida) ichki burchaklar yig'indisi 180° ga teng.

questions.text: Katetlari 3 va 4 bo'lgan to'g'ri burchakli uchburchakning gipotenuzasi nechaga teng?
questions.explanation: Pifagor teoremasi: c² = 3² + 4² = 9 + 16 = 25, demak c = 5.

questions.text: Radiusi 5 sm bo'lgan doiraning yuzi qancha (π orqali)?
questions.explanation: Doira yuzi S = πr² = π × 5² = 25π sm².

questions.text: Tomonlari 6 sm va 4 sm bo'lgan to'g'ri to'rtburchakning perimetri qancha?
questions.explanation: P = 2(a + b) = 2(6 + 4) = 20 sm. 24 sm² esa uning yuzi.

questions.text: Oltiburchak (qavariq) ichki burchaklarining yig'indisi necha gradus?
questions.explanation: n-burchak ichki burchaklari yig'indisi (n − 2) × 180°. n = 6 uchun 4 × 180° = 720°.

questions.text: Asosi 10 sm, balandligi 6 sm bo'lgan uchburchakning yuzi qancha?
questions.explanation: S = (asos × balandlik) / 2 = (10 × 6) / 2 = 30 sm².

questions.text: Qirrasi 3 sm bo'lgan kubning hajmi qancha?
questions.explanation: Kub hajmi V = a³ = 3³ = 27 sm³.

questions.text: Ikki parallel to'g'ri chiziqni kesuvchi kesib o'tganda hosil bo'lgan ichki almashinuvchi burchaklar qanday bo'ladi?
questions.explanation: Parallel to'g'ri chiziqlar va kesuvchida ichki almashinuvchi burchaklar o'zaro teng. Yig'indisi 180° bo'ladiganlar esa ichki bir tomonli burchaklar.

questions.text: Teng tomonli uchburchakning har bir burchagi necha gradus?
questions.explanation: Barcha burchaklar teng va yig'indisi 180°, demak har biri 180° / 3 = 60°.

questions.text: Aylana uzunligi 10π sm. Aylananing radiusi qancha?
questions.explanation: Aylana uzunligi C = 2πr. 2πr = 10π, demak r = 5 sm.
